article.title: How many agents will we have?

note_tweet.text:
ChatGPT Dots is exactly what we needed.

Claude Duet? Sounds like a hallucination waiting to happen.

Here's the thing nobody talks about:

- ChatGPT Dots = personal AI that lives with you, learns your workflow, anticipates needs
- Claude Duet = fancy name for "another chat interface"

The future isn't about who has better models. It's about who integrates them into your actual life.

I'm betting on the boring infrastructure play over the shiny new assistant gimmick.
